visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young toddler with black pigtails sits at a wooden table, wearing a white sweater and a light orange silicone bib. Her face and bib are stained with purple dragon fruit juice. She looks toward an off-screen person while sitting in front of a blue suction plate filled with pieces of dragon fruit, kiwi, and apple. (2) The toddler uses a small green and white fork to stab a green grape. She holds the fork up toward the camera lens, offering the fruit with a curious and expectant facial expression. (3) As she attempts to move the fork, the grape slides off and falls into the pocket of her silicone bib. She looks down at her bib, her eyes following the movement of the fallen fruit, while her hands remain near the plate. (4) She successfully retrieves the grape or another piece of fruit with her fork and again offers it to the off-screen person. When the person declines, she brings the fork to her own mouth, bites the fruit, and begins chewing with a satisfied look, looking around the room. (5) A pink graphic outro screen appears featuring a cartoon illustration of a young girl with pigtails sitting cross-legged, accompanied by English text.
